International Lubricants of Belize Ltd.

Protect what matters most. ILB distributes oils and lubricants across Belize for commercial transportation, industrial and off-highway equipment, passenger vehicles and marine use.

Product lines

  • Heavy-duty motor oils
  • Coolants and antifreeze
  • Greases
  • Hydraulic fluids
  • Gear lubricants
  • Transmission fluids

Applications

  • Commercial transportation
  • Industrial and off-highway equipment
  • Passenger vehicles
  • Marine

Order formats

Customers can order required products in the following formats.

  • Litre
  • Gallon
  • 5-gallon
  • 55-gallon drum
